'''February 2001 Columbus tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at SilverKing Comics, Columbus, Ohio on 10 February 2001. [[Jamie Abel]] won it. It is known from David Monteiro's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1729">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-13-columbus-ohio-2-10-01d1729/ columbus-ohio-2-10-01], DeckTech (David "JWRP119" Monteiro, 13 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-13-columbus-ohio-2-10-01d1729/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 February 2001
* '''Site:''' SilverKing Comics, Columbus, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[Jamie Abel]]
